ms.promise:
We will produce simplified smart contracts that support a Centralized Data Availability (“DA”) service, both bridge and client. The outputs will consist of an updated GitHub repository at a given commit, containing:
・A simplified Cardano contract for a bridge from a centralized DA, that accepts updates to the state of the DA.
・An accompanying Cardano contract for a client to this bridge, that verifies the presence of some data in the DA.
・Some automated tests that exercise the above contracts.
・Instructions on how to build and test the smart contracts.

The purpose of this deliverable is to lay the foundation for interactions between a simple bridge contract and a simple client contract on Cardano. Only as much DA functionality as strictly necessary will be implemented while laying this foundation; running the tests will NOT involve any actual off-chain service, only the on-chain smart contracts.
ms.criteria:
Criteria:
・The deliverable is to demonstrate the basic infrastructure for stateful interaction with and between two smart contracts, one for the DA bridge, one for a DA client—roughly corresponding to section 1)a) of the specification from Milestone 1, "How to maintain a unique identifiable contract state from one eUTXO to the next such that other contracts can read that state." All other details are subordinate to the implementation and validation of this infrastructure.
・The smart contracts should build, and the tests shall pass—at the specified commit.
